title: Object Storage: cool review — metered cool-storage quantity
content:
For Object Storage cool review, for a cool-storage correction, sum quantity of completed supplemental cool-class storage meters for the holding, the period of the source charge, and the source charge identified by original source reference of the authorization selected by the holding customer request reference. Add the signed quantity of posted meter reversals for that same source charge and period.
